stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 diff [-p] [--cached] [--stat] [--numstat] [--shortstat]
                  [--summary] [--name-only] [--name-status] [--raw] [--color]
                  [--no-color] [--[no-]renames] [--[no-]copies]
                  [--find-copies-harder] [<tree-ish>] [<tree-ish>] [--]
                  [<paths>...]

Show changes between commits, commit and working tree, etc.

Options:
    -p, --patch
        generate patch
    --cached
        show diff of index
    --stat
        generate diffstat
    --numstat
        generate numeric diffstat
    --shortstat
        generate short diffstat
    --summary
        generate summary
    --name-only
        show only names of changed files
    --name-status
        show names and status of changed files
    --raw
        generate diff in raw format
    --color
        use color output
    --no-color
        do not use color output
    --[no-]renames
        detect renames
    --[no-]copies
        detect copies
    --find-copies-harder
        find copies harder
    <tree-ish>
        first tree-ish to compare
    <tree-ish>
        second tree-ish to compare
    <paths>...
        limit diff to specific paths
